description: This file contains the implementation of the MembershipAgent class responsible for managing and updating the membership status of silos within the Orleans runtime. It includes methods for lifecycle management, health checks, and cluster connectivity validation.

classes.name: MembershipAgent
classes.description: Partial class implementing membership management, lifecycle participation, and health checks for Orleans silos.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Periodically updates the 'I Am Alive' timestamp in the membership table, with exponential backoff on failures.

methods.name: BecomeActive
methods.description: Transitions the silo to active state after validating initial connectivity.

methods.name: ValidateInitialConnectivity
methods.description: Checks connectivity with other silos in the cluster before fully joining.

methods.name: CheckClusterConnectivity
methods.description: Sends pings to cluster members to verify connectivity.

methods.name: ProbeSilo
methods.description: Probes a specific silo to check if it responds within a timeout.

methods.name: BecomeJoining
methods.description: Transitions the silo to joining state.

methods.name: BecomeShuttingDown
methods.description: Transitions the silo to shutting down state.

methods.name: BecomeStopping
methods.description: Transitions the silo to stopping state.

methods.name: BecomeDead
methods.description: Transitions the silo to dead state.

methods.name: UpdateStatus
methods.description: Updates the silo's status in the membership table.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Participates in the silo lifecycle, managing startup and shutdown behaviors.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes resources used by the MembershipAgent.

methods.name: CheckHealth
methods.description: Performs a health check based on the 'I Am Alive' timestamp.
